query: Please implement a 2D side-scrolling fighting game called Three Kingdoms War Chronicles. The game should have features such as character selection, skill release, and turn-based combat. Users should be able to select characters, release skills, engage in combat, and view game progress. The game should also have features such as leaderboards, stores, and character upgrades. Use a lavender blush background and apply pale violet red to the UI components.
